_about: Extra H1 research candidates per niche and category, tried after the SOP pair ("<category> <town>", "<category> services <town>"). Each term becomes "<term> <town>". "_sitewide" terms are added for the homepage and the location pages. Approved by Brandon, 18 Oct 2026, after a test on Edens Edge (gardening services, patio installers and decking installers dropped: they scored almost nothing). Plurals are not needed: Google Ads returns the same figures for singular and plural.
